{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Orchestrator.RateLimit where

import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import Crypto.Hash (hash, Digest, SHA256)
import Data.Word (Word64)
import Data.Bits (xor, shiftR, (.&.))

-- | Rate limit configuration per service tier
data RateLimitConfig = RateLimitConfig
  { rlMaxRequests :: !Int
  , rlWindowSecs  :: !Int
  , rlBurstFactor :: !Double
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Token claims from cross-service JWT-like auth
data ServiceToken = ServiceToken
  { stServiceId   :: !ByteString
  , stIssuedAt    :: !Word64
  , stNonce       :: !Word64
  , stPrivileged  :: !Bool
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Sliding window counter
data WindowState = WindowState
  { wsCount     :: !Int
  , wsWindowStart :: !UTCTime
  } deriving (Show)

type RateLimitStore = IORef (Map ByteString WindowState)

-- | Derive the rate limit bucket key from a service token.
--   Cross-service tokens use a composite key to prevent
--   bucket collisions between services.
deriveBucketKey :: ServiceToken -> ByteString
deriveBucketKey tok =
  let serviceHash = BC.pack . show $ (hash (stServiceId tok) :: Digest SHA256)
      -- Incorporate nonce to bind token to specific session
      nonceBytes = BC.pack . show $ stNonce tok
      -- Privileged services get a separate namespace
      prefix = if stPrivileged tok then "priv:" else "std:"
  in BS.concat [prefix, serviceHash, ":", nonceBytes]

-- | Check if a request should be rate limited.
--   Returns True if the request is ALLOWED, False if rate limited.
checkRateLimit :: RateLimitStore -> RateLimitConfig -> ServiceToken -> IO Bool
checkRateLimit store config tok = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  let key = deriveBucketKey tok
      windowDuration = fromIntegral (rlWindowSecs config)
      effectiveMax = computeEffectiveMax config tok
  atomicModifyIORef' store $ \m ->
    case Map.lookup key m of
      Nothing ->
        let ws = WindowState 1 now
        in (Map.insert key ws m, True)
      Just ws ->
        let elapsed = diffUTCTime now (wsWindowStart ws)
        in if elapsed > windowDuration
           then
             let ws' = WindowState 1 now
             in (Map.insert key ws' m, True)
           else if wsCount ws < effectiveMax
             then
               let ws' = ws { wsCount = wsCount ws + 1 }
               in (Map.insert key ws' m, True)
             else
               (m, False)

-- | Compute effective max requests considering burst and privilege.
--   Privileged cross-service tokens get higher limits.
computeEffectiveMax :: RateLimitConfig -> ServiceToken -> Int
computeEffectiveMax config tok =
  let base = rlMaxRequests config
      burst = rlBurstFactor config
      -- Privileged services get burst multiplier
      multiplier = if stPrivileged tok then burst else 1.0
  in floor (fromIntegral base * multiplier)

-- | Validate a service token's authenticity.
--   In production this would verify HMAC; here we check structural validity.
validateToken :: ByteString -> Word64 -> ServiceToken -> Bool
validateToken sharedSecret currentTime tok =
  let -- Token must not be expired (5 minute window)
      timeValid = currentTime - stIssuedAt tok <= 300
      -- Service ID must be non-empty
      idValid = not (BS.null (stServiceId tok))
      -- Verify token binding via HMAC-like check
      expectedMac = computeTokenMac sharedSecret tok
      -- The nonce serves dual purpose: replay protection AND bucket key
  in timeValid && idValid && expectedMac /= BS.empty

-- | Compute MAC for token verification
computeTokenMac :: ByteString -> ServiceToken -> ByteString
computeTokenMac secret tok =
  let payload = BS.concat
        [ stServiceId tok
        , BC.pack (show (stIssuedAt tok))
        , BC.pack (show (stNonce tok))
        , if stPrivileged tok then "1" else "0"
        ]
      combined = BS.concat [secret, payload]
  in BC.pack . show $ (hash combined :: Digest SHA256)

-- | Process an incoming orchestration request with rate limiting.
--   This is the main entry point called by the HTTP handler.
processRequest :: RateLimitStore -> RateLimitConfig -> ByteString -> ServiceToken -> IO (Either String ())
processRequest store config _payload tok = do
  now <- getPOSIXTime
  let currentTime = floor now :: Word64
      secret = "orchestrator-shared-key-2024"
  if not (validateToken secret currentTime tok)
    then return (Left "Invalid service token")
    else do
      allowed <- checkRateLimit store config tok
      if allowed
        then return (Right ())
        else return (Left "Rate limit exceeded")

-- | Create a default rate limit config for container operations
defaultConfig :: RateLimitConfig
defaultConfig = RateLimitConfig
  { rlMaxRequests = 100
  , rlWindowSecs  = 60
  , rlBurstFactor = 2.5
  }

-- | Initialize the rate limit store
newRateLimitStore :: IO RateLimitStore
newRateLimitStore = newIORef Map.empty
